data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 17.8m (2015: favourable development of GBP 16.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business and GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves developed favourably overall. The Syndicate reports net releases on prior years (net of reinsurance) of GBP 17.8m driven primarily by releases in Third Party Liability and small releases in Aviation/Transport and Reinsurance. A gross prior-year analysis derived from the published gross claims development triangle indicates a net gross release of c. GBP 8.94m across older underwriting years (2011-2014). The movement reflects favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries, with the published movement note giving the net (after-reinsurance) figure.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes

data.data_quality_notes: Primary preferred source for prior year movement (Movement in prior year's provision) provided only NET of reinsurance (GBP 17.8m). A gross movement figure is not disclosed in that note, so a gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (gross table) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2014. The triangle-derived gross PYD is -8.941m (release). The difference between the net movement reported (-17.8m net release) and the triangle-derived gross release may reflect reinsurance timing/allocations, aggregated '2010 & prior' column excluded from triangle calculation, or differences in scope between the narrative note and the triangle. Where LOB-level amounts are quoted in the movement note they are NET of reinsurance and have been used for LOB movements (not gross).
